verdict.rationale: Hatchet's docs have a dedicated self-hosting section for running your own instance of the Hatchet Control Plane, which orchestrates workflows, schedules tasks, and coordinates workers, and the engine's code is on GitHub. Community threads independently confirm that self-hosted quickstart docs exist and discuss the operational stack, including the RabbitMQ dependency alongside Postgres. Missing for 10: detailed deployment evidence (e.g., Docker/Helm/Kubernetes guides), an explicit open-source license or feature-parity statement versus the cloud plans, and a lighter self-hosting footprint than the reported RabbitMQ dependency.
